description: This file defines the Kpi entity class for the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It maps to the 'ohrm_kpi' database table and includes properties such as id, title, rating bounds, default status, deletion timestamp, and related JobTitle. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for ORM mapping and includes methods for accessing and mutating its properties.

classes.name: Kpi
classes.description: Entity class representing a Key Performance Indicator with properties for ID, title, ratings, related job title, deletion timestamp, and default KPI flag, with ORM mapping annotations and accessor/mutator methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the KPI.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the KPI.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the KPI.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the KPI.

methods.name: getMinRating
methods.description: Returns the minimum rating for the KPI.

methods.name: setMinRating
methods.description: Sets the minimum rating for the KPI.

methods.name: getMaxRating
methods.description: Returns the maximum rating for the KPI.

methods.name: setMaxRating
methods.description: Sets the maximum rating for the KPI.

methods.name: isDefaultKpi
methods.description: Returns whether the KPI is marked as default.

methods.name: setDefaultKpi
methods.description: Sets whether the KPI is marked as default.

methods.name: getDeletedAt
methods.description: Returns the DateTime when the KPI was deleted.

methods.name: setDeletedAt
methods.description: Sets the DateTime when the KPI was deleted.
